value.name: Sarah offers Marylin shelter
value.description: Sarah tells Marylin she can stay in the beach house for as long as she wants.
evidence: SARAH Well, you can live here as long as you want.

value.name: Sarah asks Marylin about her plans
value.description: Sarah asks Marylin whether she has any immediate plans for the future.

value.name: Marylin says she will have her own place soon
value.description: Marylin answers that she has nothing specific planned but expects to have her own place soon.
evidence: MARYLIN Nothing specific, but I'll have my own place soon.

value.name: Sarah questions Marylin's childhood identity
value.description: Sarah presses Marylin about whether she identified herself that way as a little girl.
evidence: SARAH So, Marylin. Is that what you said when you were a little girl?

value.name: Marylin reflects on family divorce patterns
value.description: Marylin explains that women in her family were repeatedly divorced, shaping how she saw herself growing up.
evidence: MARYLIN Probably. Every woman in my life was divorced at least twice. What was I supposed to say. Anthropologist?

value.name: Ramona recalls begging for a baby
value.description: Ramona interjects that she had begged Marylin to have a baby, revealing a past conflict or pressure.
evidence: RAMONA I begged you to have a baby!

value.name: Marylin compares herself to Godfather scene
value.description: Marylin invokes a violent Godfather scene to frame her own situation as one of betrayal and impending retaliation.
evidence: MARYLIN In the Godfather, after the courtroom scene, Frankie Pentangeli opens his veins in the bathtub.

value.name: Sarah fears Marylin may be suicidal
value.description: Sarah reacts anxiously to Marylin's violent reference, worried that she might be talking about harming herself.

value.name: Marylin vows to see blood before ending struggle
value.description: Marylin clarifies that she will not kill herself, but she intends to see blood before her conflict is over and it will be someone else's.
evidence: MARYLIN No. I'll see some blood before this is over, but it won't be mine.
